doc: World state the acts read and change, so chains are PLANNED instead of listed. A fluent is a fact about him or the room (teeth clean, food cooked, dishes dirty, caffeine in the blood). Per act: guard = must already hold or the act makes no sense (no brushing clean teeth); pre = must hold, and if not the planner inserts acts that make it hold (no eating without food -> cook -> fridge); pre_any = one of these must hold; soft = wanted but skippable (brush before sleep), kept with a probability that falls with tiredness and stress; eff = what the act changes; fail = what changes instead when the act fails (burnt food uses the ingredients). Values: 0/1, '+n' / '-n' add or take away (portions), ttl = minutes a fact stays true, halfLife = minutes for a level to halve. needs: a fact in the world that pulls an act up by itself (dirty dishes ask to be washed; being undressed in the day asks to dress). The named chains in chains.json stay as recognised motifs (labels and ledger bonuses); they no longer have to list every way a day can go. pay_any = how much the act pays with each pre_any option (a cooked meal fills more than a snack from the fridge); the planner weighs it when choosing. Round 5: inspired / news / paint give art, music and social acts steps of their own (a record or a book before playing, something to tell before a call or a letter, paint washed off before eating or playing). softKeep (per act) scales how often he keeps its soft steps.

food.label: cooked portions left (leftovers keep about 12 h)

voided.label: been to the loo just now

inspired.label: an idea or a feeling to work from (a record, a book, the gallery); fades in about 2.5 h

news.label: something to tell someone (a piece finished, something played or read); stale after a day

needs.why: food is ready and getting cold
still in pyjamas in the day

caffeine.doc: tea appeal / (1 + appealK * caffeine level); after lateFrom it is also multiplied by lateMul (people avoid caffeine before bed)

soft.doc: chance he keeps a soft step = base + energy*(energy motive) + stress*(stress) + habit*(how often he kept it), clamped .1-.98

planner.doc: means-ends planning to depth maxDepth; the order of independent steps is drawn from act-to-act affinity times (1 + habitW * learned pair habit), habits fade over habitTau minutes
